Title: Beyonder Clan
ChangeLog:
Version 0.9.9: [Bux Fix] Playing Manic Disorder at high ember values is now restricted to shuffling the deck once, after which cards cycle back through the draw pile. This mitigates a glitch that can happen if the deck fails to reshuffle properly, resulting in adding multiple fake copies of a card to the deck.

 [Bug Fix] Cards with the 'Purge' trait will now properly be removed from the deck if playing them causes the deck to be reshuffled. This was affecting spellchain copies of cards that could draw multiple cards like Manic Disorder or Awoken's Railspike.

 [Bug Fix] Cave of a Thousand Eyes' pyre damage on reserve no longer scales with attack upgrades.
